include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/libs/fmifs)

# chkdsk.exe is all Rust (chkdsk-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/chkdsk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# chkdsk.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/chkdsk-rust/src/chkdsk/chkdsk.rs)
add_cargo_module(chkdsk chkdsk-cargo chkdsk.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE chkdsk-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
